PLAN "Deload Week — Post-Hypertrophy"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Deload and recovery"

PHASES
  PHASE "Deload" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Push":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Tuesday training 45m "Lower Pull":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 2x3..5 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 2x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 30m "Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Upper Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_row 3x5..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Lower Push":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 2x4..6 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          front_squat 2x5..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          leg_extension 2x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 2x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Saturday training 30m "Full Body Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          thoracic_mobility 2x5..8 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x1..1 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          cat_cow 2x8..12 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          pigeon_pose 5m
      DAY Sunday training 20m "Recovery Cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 20m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x1..1 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 5m
